:::{#rem-polynomial-nonzero}
#### Constant and zero polynomials

A [constant function](#def-constant-function) $f(x) = 7$ is a polynomial with $n = 0$ and $a_0 = 7$.
The requirement $a_n \ne 0$ means this definition covers nonzero polynomials only:
the zero function $f(x) = 0$ is excluded here,
because it has no nonzero coefficient to serve as $a_n$.

:::
